EGY.note: The press release states no rule or authority on AI harms.

facts.fact: The Central Agency for Organization and Administration launched the AI chatbot KMT, which answers more than 50,000 civil-service legal and administrative questions for civil servants and the public via its website, WhatsApp and Facebook, according to the USAID Economic Governance Activity press release.

systems.owner: Central Agency for Organization and Administration (CAOA)

EGY.note: KMT is a general civil-service chatbot, not a sector system.
KMT is a government chatbot; the release gives no local AI model release, dataset or AI computing as such.
No digital-skills training for civil servants is stated.
Widebot is mentioned only as the chatbot's builder; no startup law, labelling or fund is stated.
No technology hub or park is stated.
